source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Use it in your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets. Pick 1 **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit of yours that any of those attacks target.

Until the enemy unit has finished attacking, each attack aimed at your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

windows.timing: just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
just after an enemy unit has selected its targets

detail.duration: until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Armoured Speartip Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
